tagline.en: Easy, fast, and cheap omni-modality model serving for everyone.
tagline.zh: 让全模态模型服务变得简单、快速、经济，面向每一位开发者。

detail.en: Explore the project’s approach to omni-modality model serving. Read the architecture, supported models, and setup instructions in the official repository.
detail.zh: 探索全模态模型服务的开放实现，在项目仓库中了解架构、支持的模型与部署方式。

tagline.en: A vLLM external plugin for Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD).
tagline.zh: 面向 Attention-FFN 分离（AFD）的 vLLM 外部插件。

detail.en: An experimental project exploring Attention-FFN Disaggregation. Consult its repository for current status, supported configurations, and implementation details.
detail.zh: 探索 Attention-FFN 分离的实验性项目。请在仓库中查看当前状态、支持的配置与实现细节。

tagline.en: A high-performance, lightweight request forwarding system for large-scale vLLM deployments.
tagline.zh: 面向大规模 vLLM 部署的高性能、轻量级请求转发系统。

detail.en: Explore request forwarding for large-scale vLLM deployments, with project documentation and architecture available in the official repository.
detail.zh: 探索大规模 vLLM 部署中的请求转发。在项目仓库中查看架构、文档与使用方式。

tagline.en: A vLLM-based inference framework for agentic workloads.
tagline.zh: 基于 vLLM，面向智能体工作负载的推理框架。

detail.en: Discover an inference framework focused on agentic workloads. Explore the framework architecture and follow the repository for current setup and integration guidance.
detail.zh: 聚焦智能体工作负载，探索推理框架架构，并在项目仓库中查看最新的配置与集成指南。

tagline.en: A standalone inference and serving engine for recurrent looped transformers.
tagline.zh: 面向循环迭代 Transformer（recurrent looped transformers）的独立推理与服务引擎。

detail.en: Explore standalone inference and serving for recurrent looped transformers. The poster-matched diagram illustrates the repeated-pass concept; consult the repository for implementation details.
detail.zh: 探索循环迭代 Transformer 的独立推理与模型服务。海报同款架构图展示了多轮计算的概念；具体实现请参阅项目仓库。

tagline.en: A lightweight Apple Silicon counterpart of vLLM-Omni.
tagline.zh: 面向 Apple Silicon 的轻量级 vLLM-Omni 对应实现。

detail.en: Explore a lightweight approach to omni-modality inference on Apple Silicon. Check the repository for supported features, model compatibility, and local setup.
detail.zh: 探索 Apple Silicon 上的轻量级全模态推理。在项目仓库中了解支持的功能、模型兼容性与本地使用方式。

tagline.zh: 以可验证的实验，推动推理优化与专用引擎探索。
tagline.en: Turn inference bottlenecks into verifiable improvements.

detail.zh: 面向编码智能体的推理优化 CLI 工作台：从性能剖析、重复 A/B 实验与质量检查，到可追溯的证据报告和经验复用。用户提供实验命令并驱动代码修改；并非已实现的全自动优化系统。下方 InferRSI 专区展示两个专用语音引擎案例。
detail.en: A CLI workbench for inference optimization with coding agents: profiling, repeated A/B experiments, quality gates, traceable evidence and reusable lessons. Users supply experiment commands and drive code changes; this is not a fully autonomous optimizer. Explore two dedicated speech-engine examples in the InferRSI section below.
